# Web Awesome Spinner 3.14.0

- Component: [Web Awesome Spinner](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/spinner/).
- npm entry: `@awesome.me/webawesome@3.14.0/dist/components/spinner/spinner.js`.
- Browser ESM bundle produced from the npm entry using esbuild 0.28.2,
  with `--bundle --format=esm --target=chrome110 --minify --legal-comments=inline`.
- Resolved runtime packages: `@awesome.me/webawesome@3.14.0`,
  `@shoelace-style/localize@3.2.3`, `lit@3.3.3`, `lit-element@4.2.2`,
  `lit-html@3.3.3`, and `@lit/reactive-element@2.1.2`. Notices: [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- The bundle has no external imports. The desktop loads it only from the
  installed UI directory, without widening the Content Security Policy.
